issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires defining `status_flag` as a single byte (db). The solution repository instead defines `status_flag` using `dd` (a 4-byte double word). This is a direct type/size mismatch for the same symbol and will confuse students: they are instructed to create a one-byte flag but the provided reference solution uses a four-byte definition. Students comparing their work with the solution may be uncertain which is correct and could introduce bugs related to data size/alignment.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the solution to define the flag as a single byte to match the specification: replace `status_flag dd 1` with `status_flag db 1`. If the intention was to use a 4-byte value, update the problem statement to state that `status_flag` should be a 4-byte word instead.
